experience.loadingHelp: Checking the local network service. Your rooms will appear when it responds.
experience.unavailableHelp: We cannot confirm your game connection. The background service may still be running. Keep this window open while we reconnect, or open diagnostics for help.
experience.stale: Connection status is out of date
experience.staleHelp: The last status is shown below. Changes are paused until the service responds; your game connection has not been confirmed.
experience.setupHelp: Choose a display name to play as a guest, or sign in to your account.
experience.accountHelp: Open your account to check your sign-in status before joining a room.
experience.idleHelp: Create a room for your friends or join with an invite code.
experience.joiningHelp: Your room is being synchronized. You do not need to join again.
experience.preparingHelp: You have joined the room. Wait for the network adapter and room authorization to be ready before opening the in-game LAN menu.
experience.readyHelp: Open your game to host or join a LAN session. Check connection quality in the room member table. A ready network does not mean the other player has started the game.

experience.pausedHelp: This device is not connected to the game network. You are still a room member. Resume when you are ready to play.

experience.disabledHelp: The administrator has disabled networking for this game. You can still manage or leave the room.
experience.failedHelp: You are in the room, but the game connection is not ready. Open diagnostics to identify the problem, then try connecting again.
experience.updateHelp: Open Settings to check the update and continue. Account access and diagnostics are still available.
experience.actionsUnavailable: Waiting for a current response from the local service.
experience.actionsPending: We are checking an earlier action. New room changes are paused to avoid submitting it twice.

experience.actionsOffline: Room changes will be available when the room service reconnects.
experience.pendingHelp: The response was interrupted. We are checking the original action automatically. Do not create another room or reuse the invite yet.
experience.unresolvedTitle: The original result is no longer available

experience.workingHelp: Waiting for confirmation. You can keep this window open; submitting again is unnecessary.
experience.problemTitle: This action could not be completed
experience.staleAction: The room changed while you were working. Refresh, review the new information, and confirm your action again.
